_comment: Captured verbatim from a live GET /v1/prices/calendar call against api.travelpayouts.com on 2026-07-24 (origin=MSP, destination=CUN, depart_date=2026-08, calendar_type=departure_date). No token or other credential is present in this file. Demonstrates the real-world quirk: this endpoint's per-entry date fields are `departure_at`/`return_at` (matching prices_for_dates), NOT `depart_date`/`return_date` as older TravelPayouts docs/examples show — see docs/PROVIDERS.md 'Real-world response notes'. Also demonstrates that a month-granularity depart_date request can return entries outside the requested calendar month (2027-06-02 here, for a 2026-08 request).
